text: CASH RECEIPTS INFO Credit Sale Policy: Customers must pay in the month following the sale. For example, if Company sells units to customer in January then the Company expects to receive that payment from customer in February. Questions: Based on the cash sales and the cash received from credit sales, how much cash will Company receive in January, February and March? How much will still be in Accounts Receivable as of March 31st (how much of the credit sales have they not received payment for??)
